# Gazette browser search consumer

Byte-retained `@rtepl/gazette/search` 0.1.0 export from Gazette’s `sdk/js/search`, captured on 2026-11-21. No native engine implementation or addon is included. These files are licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0, in LICENSE, with Gazette’s notice in NOTICE. The unchanged Elasticlunr dependency has its complete MIT licence, embedded bundle notice and provenance in vendor/.

Reproduce by copying the named files from that SDK export and verifying these SHA-256 values. Source modifications require a new explicit capture and hashes.
